messages:
kai: FYI - customer CI started failing intermittently with 401 from our private module proxy when running `go get` :confused:

kai: root log snippet:
```
go: downloading github.com/customer/privmod v0.0.0-00010101000000-abcdef123456
401 Unauthorized: authentication required

# attempt 2/3: succeed after retry but with long delay ~18s
```

olivia: thanks, can you paste the exact repro steps + go version? also which proxy (GOPROXY) are they using?

kai: go1.20.7 in CI, GOPROXY=https://proxy.company.internal, they sometimes get 401 on first fetch, then go retries and it works. happens only when fetching by tag `release-2026-rc1` which is a lightweight annotated tag the customer uses.

rahul: sounds like proxy auth + tag resolution race. `go` will list pseudo-version based on tags/commit; if the tag was pushed after the auth token expired on the proxy side, the first request can 401 while subsequent fetch uses cached commit info.

olivia: quick checks: ensure CI does a `git fetch --tags` before `go get` when using `GOPRIVATE` or private git backends. also verify `GOPRIVATE`/`GONOSUMDB` envs set so checksum/proxy behavior bypasses public sums.

kai: they've got `GOPRIVATE=github.com/customer/*` in CI, but their repo is accessed via company proxy which needs a short-lived token from our SSO. token rotation might align with the failure window.

eng-support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 - module fetch 401s from proxy during tag push. Link: https://issues.redwood/in/INC-2026-042 :ticket:

rahul: workaround for now: pin the module to a pseudo-version or commit SHA in `go.mod` (e.g., `github.com/customer/privmod v0.0.0-20260115-abcdef123456`) or make sure tags are pushed before proxy token rotation. also don't push annotated/lightweight tags that are later replaced.

olivia: another permanent fix: publish a semver tag (v1.2.3) for modules intended for public fetches or update proxy auth to accept the tag push window. Customer ops: can you coordinate with the customer to avoid re-tagging the same ref? :pray:

customer-ops: pinged customer, they confirmed they re-tag `release-2026-rc1` a few times while iterating. they can stop re-using the same tag.

kai: adding quick snippet to recommend for CI to reduce flakiness:
```bash
# ensure tags and full git history before go get
git fetch --prune --unshallow --tags origin +refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*
export GOPRIVATE=github.com/customer/*
export GONOSUMDB=github.com/customer/*
# pin by pseudo-version to avoid tag lookup race
go get github.com/customer/privmod@v0.0.0-20260115-abcdef123456
```

olivia: will follow up with engineering to add a KB entry. marking as triaged for now :thumbsup:

kai: closing loop with customer after they confirm change, will update INC ticket and reopen if needed.
